notes.title: ⚙️ Introducing Brave New Wonders 🌎
notes.notes:
Hey Detectives,

We’ve got some huge news to share — our next game is officially announced, and we couldn’t be more excited to finally reveal it to you.

Brave New Wonders is a factory automation strategy simulation game with AI automatons. In a post-apocalyptic world, you can command automatons with plain text instructions in any language to explore ruins, battle with enemies, construct factories, automate production lines and build your amazing wonders.

[previewyoutube=UU4soSSsC-E;full][/previewyoutube]
🌟 What makes it unique?
🤖Intelligent Automatons: Command the automaton army with written English instructions. Backed by LLM, you can use natural language to tell automatons what to do, and they will follow.

🧭Explore Floating Islands: Wander in this post-apocalyptic world, discover ruins from the last civilization, and collect treasures to inspire your people to develop new technologies.

⚙️A Living Tech Tree: Hear people’s requests and make decisions. Your decision will affect the branching of your tech tree, it’s different every time for every player.

☀️Build Massive Wonders: The Wonders serve as symbols of human achievement. Harness the power of Levitanium and steam to drive technological advancements, improving the quality of life and securing the future of your society.

👉 Wishlist Brave New Wonders now to stay up to date: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403830/Brave_New_Wonders 

Thanks for being part of our journey! Your support means everything. Let’s build something wonderful together. ⚙️



Stay Curious,
Sala
@ City From Naught Team

notes.title: Keyword 2: Nightfall is Announced on Steam. 1st Trailer Unveiled!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Detectives! 🌆

We're overjoyed to announce that the sequel to [i]Keyword: A Spider's Thread[/i], titled [i]Keyword 2: Nightfall[/i], is officially in the works! 

[i]Keyword 2: Nightfall[/i] Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015470

Your unwavering support for the first game has inspired our development team to go all-in, and we're committed to crafting an even more captivating and authentic detective gaming experience.

But that's not all! We're excited to present the FIRST TRAILER that offers a sneak peek into the mesmerizing world of [i]Keyword 2: Nightfall[/i]:

Stay updated on all things [i]Keyword 2: Nightfall[/i] - Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/cityfromnaught]X (Twitter)[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cj2EYpY]Discord Server[/url]. The night is calling, and the mysteries await.

notes.title: Cyber Manhunt and Keyword: A Spider's Thread Collaboration!
notes.notes:
Hey Detectives:

We are happy to announce that Keyword: A Spider's Thread will have a collaboration with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1216710/Cyber_Manhunt/]Cyber Manhunt[/url] and initiate a discount campaign!

Cyber Manhunt is a story-oriented puzzle game made by Aluba Studio. We shared the same topic on hunting down truths on the internet, which bonded us together. You can find easter eggs in each game, and we hope you can enjoy both of them!

For players who own Cyber Manhunt, you can get another [b]10% off[/b] on top of the launch discount from September 28th to October 5th. Let's uncover the mysteries together!

notes.title: Demo available now till Oct 7th!
notes.notes:
To Celebrate the date announcement for Keyword: A Spider's thread public release on [b]September 28th[/b], we reactivated the Demo for everyone to play again and added a secret puzzle at the end. 

Beat the demo and solve the secret puzzle for a chance to win ANY game of your choice! 

[h3]Step 1[/h3]
Download The Keyword: A Spider’s Thread Demo on Steam
Use your detective skills to find the hidden puzzle webpage. 

[h3]Step 2[/h3]
Solve the puzzle. Submit your answer and email on the website. Our “investigation agency” will randomly select a few detectives to receive Steam gift cards ($3-5 USD in value).

[h3]More rewards[/h3]
If you didn’t receive a gift card, you’ll have another chance!
Every detective that solves the puzzle will receive a unique detective ID number. [url=https://twitter.com/cityfromnaught/status/1439289182707503106?s=20]Retweet or comment this post [/url]with your detective ID and #KeywordASpidersThread for a chance to win:

A copy of [url=https://journal29.com/]Journal 29: Interactive Book Game[/url]* x 3
A [url=https://store.steampowered.com/]Steam game[/url] of your choice**  x 1


[i]*USA and Canada only. Winners outside of these jurisdictions will receive a gift card ($18 USD in value).
**Restrictions apply. Game must be available on Steam with a MSRP of $60 USD or less. [/i]

notes.title: Keyword developer live-stream and Q&A
notes.notes:
Hey detectives,

Come and join the first-ever Keyword demo stream! 

The devs will also be on the Stream ready to answer any questions and spill dev behind-the-scenes info. We certainly hope you have a chance to check out and play the demo yourself. Make sure to check it out since it will only be available until the end of June. 

And don't forget to wishlist Keyword so you can be the first to know when it launches. Can't wait to hear what you think as you explore your inner-detective spirit!



City From Naught
